interpretation.liveInventory: verified nonzero token balance in a PDA-derived Kamino Lend or Project 0/marginfi liquidity vault; this is an upper-bound inventory observation, not proof the full amount can be flash-borrowed
interpretation.atomicV1Envelope: 4096-byte transaction and 64 inline-account ceiling supplied by the audit specification; generic Project 0 v1 start/borrow/repay/end composition is separately proven in project0-v1-composition.json
interpretation.priorityCandidate: same mint plus successful outgoing program-signer evidence; a program-specific combined read-only simulation is still required before saying the target exit is atomically reachable
